framing.seed: pass i's seed = receipts.seed(challenge, i, previous): previous is the registration digest at i = 0 and pass i - 1's root after
framing.signs: 16 rows of 1,028 bytes; bit x of a row (byte x // 8, LSB first) 1 means -1, 0 means +1; block j reads bytes 257 (j mod 4) to 257 (j mod 4) + 256 of each row
framing.partial: block j's: row c's sum over x < 2056 of sign(row c, 2056 (j mod 4) + x) * int8(C*[2056 j + x]), 16 int32 little-endian, one entry a block in block order
framing.sigma: unit g's: its blocks 4g .. 4g + 3's partials summed row by row, 16 int32 little-endian
framing.root: receipts.tree(seed, Plan.whole(units), receipts, leaf_salts).commitment.root, sixteen receipts a leaf
